definitions.definition: The /s/ sound represented by c in taught words such as cent and city.
The /k/ sound represented by c in taught words such as cat and cup.
Applying a learned skill to a new example.

workedExamples.prompt: Compare “cent” and “cat”. What sound does c represent?
workedExamples.solution: In cent, c represents /s/; in cat, c represents /k/.

workedExamples.prompt: A learner reads “city” with /k/. What should be checked?
workedExamples.solution: Notice i after c, apply the taught soft-c pattern, and reread the word.
A new item checks independent use of the spelling pattern.
